I agree with the Router that no structural or functional features can be verified.
artifact_review: The Router correctly identified 'blur' as a Severity 5 artifact. This is the dominant failure mode. The 'texture_anomaly' (Severity 4) and 'fusion' (Severity 4) are also accurate descriptions of how the instrument melts into the background and lacks surface detail. The 'perceptual_quality_auditor' confirmed 'serious' blur. The 'fine_grained_classifier' failing to identify the bassoon (predicting 'candle' instead) is strong evidence that the image lacks the semantic features of the target class. The topology mask confidence is high, but this likely reflects the model segmenting the blurry blob rather than confirming structural integrity.
alignment_reasoning: The image fails to demonstrate any verifiable features of a bassoon. The fine-grained classifier misidentified the object as a candle/spotlight, indicating a complete lack of class-specific visual cues. All diagnostic checkpoints are either untestable due to blur or visibly absent. The alignment is effectively zero, with a tiny non-zero score only acknowledging the vague brown vertical shape that might loosely correspond to a woodwind body.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from catastrophic motion blur (Severity 5), rendering it nearly abstract. This causes severe texture anomalies (melting/smearing) and boundary fusion with the background. The quality is comparable to or worse than the 'bannister' reference (Artifact 1.0), which had clear geometry but wrong class. Here, the geometry itself is destroyed by blur.
